$$
\text{Percentage Total Return} = \left( \frac{350.82 - 100.98}{100.98} \right) \times 100
$$

$$
350.82 - 100.98 = 249.84
$$

Calculate the percentage:  
$$
\left( \frac{249.84}{100.98} \right) \times 100 \approx 247.43
$$

Final answer: 247.43
